_template: Person record for a figure who may contest the character. Copy into a world_upsert operation (or the setup state's world.records) under a stable lowercase ID, fill every value, and delete this key and any detail you cannot support. Values in details must be nonempty strings; a capability rating is the number as a string with its basis beside it. Do not copy a person from another story.
summary: Who this person is at the story's current moment, in one or two plain sentences.

details.goals: What this person is trying to do now, as far as the record can establish it; revised when play shows otherwise.
details.pc_knowledge: What the character actually knows or has heard of this person, and from whom.
details.<Ability name> basis: Why that rating, from established history, held to the same evidence standard as the character sheet. The ability name is the key an adjudication references (source world.records.<id>.details).
details.limits: What this person cannot do or does not know, where established.
